title: Sit With the One Who Knows
hook: Rumi had one piece of advice about who to sit with.

segments.fa: دلا نزد کسی بنشین که او از دل خبر دارد
segments.en: O heart, sit near someone who knows the heart.

segments.fa: به زیر آن درختی رو که او گل‌های تر دارد
segments.en: Go under the tree that bears fresh flowers.

segments.fa: به دکان کسی بنشین که در دکان شکر دارد
segments.en: Sit at the shop of the one who has sugar.

tafsir: Rumi is speaking to his own heart.
In the full couplet, he warns: do not wander the perfume market like the idle.
So many stalls, so many voices. Do not drift from one to the next.
Find the one whose shop holds real sweetness, and stay.
This week in our serial, Shams comes back to Konya.

outro.say: Shams and Rumi, the serial, is on our page. Follow The Guest House.
